name: AvtoGen
tagline: Car-wash search and queue booking across Uzbekistan, with a companion app for wash staff
role: Client and staff mobile apps for a car-wash booking service

scenes.title: Find a car wash near you
scenes.body: A search zooms the map to your location and pins the washes nearby.

scenes.title: Car type, services, time
scenes.body: One draggable card walks through the steps; its button fills as each is done.

scenes.title: Prices first, then a queue slot
scenes.body: Each wash totals your services and shows today's hours; bookings then await its reply.

scenes.title: A separate app for wash staff
scenes.body: New requests come with a two-minute timer; details show the car model and plate.

scenes.title: Rebuilt in 2022 with a new UI
scenes.body: React Native 0.67 and Redux Toolkit: OTP login, service categories, persisted session.
